title: Puzzle button
description: Soft-cornered buttons in six fills: ink, soft violet, a slightly lifted card-dark, white, and outlines for light and violet backgrounds. Solid fills ease to the deep brand violet on hover (0.2s, 0.4s for the card-dark one), outlines take a faint wash; an optional arrow nudges right.
notes: the deep violet hover fill is the primary token
the 'on-dark' variants are for primary-coloured bands
